title: Construction account for two Drinfeld-center A4 MTC FR artifacts
purpose: Record the mathematical construction recipe that explains where the two canonical D(A4) MTC F/R-symbol artifacts come from, without importing the dirty exploratory constructor as normative source.

claim_boundary.established: The two canonical FR artifacts are presented as numeric F/R data for the listed Drinfeld-center categories, with simple-object classification, twisting source, basis convention, and extraction principle recorded here.
not_claimed: Exact arithmetic proof of all F/R entries
A standalone symbolic derivation of every F/R entry
c3w2, order-2 twist, or full Z/6 family

c3w1.twisting_source: Inflation of the order-three normalized cocycle on A4/V4 ~= C3

group_data.permutation_model: even permutations of {0,1,2,3}, composed as left after right

quotient.name: A4/V4
quotient.quotient_exponent_rule: q(g) is the exponent e in {0,1,2} such that g lies in V4 * quotient_generator^e

conjugacy_classes.representative_description: the first sorted double transposition in the permutation model

simple_object_recipe.principle: Simple objects are indexed by pairs (C, pi), where C is an A4 conjugacy class and pi is an irreducible representation of the centralizer of a chosen representative; in the c3w1 twisted case pi is replaced by the DPR alpha-projective representation for classes affected by the inflated cocycle.

c3w1.projective_centralizer_effect: For 3A and 3B centralizers, DPR alpha-projective one-dimensional reps have generator values among ninth roots; this is the construction-level source of the primitive ninth-root twists in c3w1.

fr_extraction_recipe.object_model: Induced Yetter-Drinfeld modules over A4, with degree decomposition over conjugacy-class elements and A4 action induced from centralizer data plus DPR action scalars in the twisted case.
fr_extraction_recipe.hom_basis: For labels a,b,c, Hom(a tensor b, c) is computed as the nullspace of equivariance equations respecting degrees and A4 action.
fr_extraction_recipe.f_symbol_convention: F_block columns are right-associated tree basis vectors expressed in the left-associated tree basis.
fr_extraction_recipe.r_symbol_convention: R_block columns are Hom(b tensor a, c) basis vectors braided into Hom(a tensor b, c).
fr_extraction_recipe.braiding_origin: The braiding is the Drinfeld-center/Yetter-Drinfeld braiding: a homogeneous vector of degree g acts on the second tensor factor by g before swapping tensor factors; twisted associator and DPR scalars modify the c3w1 numeric path.
fr_extraction_recipe.coherence_test_principle: All-label pentagon, right-hexagon, and left-hexagon scans compare the F/R formula paths for every label tuple; recorded tuple counts are 14^5, 14^4, and 14^4 respectively.
